_comment: A frozen verdict per published record, with the exact command that produces it. Any checker change must reproduce every row. A record whose inputs are not published in this repository cannot be frozen; it is listed under `unfreezable` with the reason, and `legacy: true` marks the five published before this table existed - a record without that flag cannot be parked here.

rows.command: python3 checker/check.py examples/minimal/record.json --files examples/minimal --evidence examples/minimal/evidence --bar examples/minimal/bar.md
